name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.113.0 — the design atlas gains a screen index and two-way note navigation: `page()` carries the `#shell`/`#toc`/`.tocgroup`/`.tochead`/`.tocrow`/`.tocempty`/`#tocbtn`/`#tocscrim` register and `buildAtlas` alone emits the markup (a gallery still renders none), so `design/atlas/index.html` has a sticky index column at wide widths and an off-canvas overlay below 1200px — one row per journey, screen and candidate, a search box filtering the index only, the existing status chips filtering index and cards together, a heading jumping to its section and a row to its card, and a current-section marker derived from a scroll threshold (an IntersectionObserver band was executed and marked nothing). `/__notes/list` gains `screen=**` (every note, no scope filter; `screen=*` and `screen=<label>` byte-for-byte unchanged), so the atlas project panel reaches a note written about one screen: it renders a `button.nl-anchor` labelled `<screen> · <state>` that opens that screen in the lightbox when the card carries an `iframe.frame`, an inert `span.nl-anchor.plain` when it does not, and the screen alone when the note carries no state; a served mock page's strip keeps its `<b>` id badge and gains one `a.nl-up` back to the panel. No deep link into a state. Also: the gate caps test-file parallelism at `--test-concurrency=3`, and three prose-size caps rise ten lines each. 7.112.0 — The release stage's e2e leg now reds on an unobserved run — an observed zero executed count, or a declared count format that never matched — and the journeys leg reds when zero journeys were walked; the count parsers plus the unobserved predicate now live in one shared module that both review-legs.js and release-legs.js import instead of each declaring their own. 7.111.0 — token-cost trims for Fable 5.1 seats: core § Session Execution (edit-don't-rewrite, act on enough information, no extras, batch calls) served by every shared-for list; shared-for gains init (no more whole-doctrine fail-open) and run-design (the delta /spec:run's Design stage loads; build/review stages skip their own shared-for); shared-genesis/shared-mocks --section slice one supplement section and both drivers print the slice per step, so the 50 KB / 23 KB supplements are never read whole; shared-for stops echoing frontmatter; the plugin description's changelog paragraphs are one line each. Published as 7.111.0 after a concurrent session claimed 7.110.0.
